svg.text: I turn ideas into real web products. End-to-end UI, APIs & data.

g.text: Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology
• Develop responsive, performant enterprise business websites & reusable UI architectures.
• Translate Figma design systems into pixel-accurate frontends with strict Git/GitHub workflows.
• Developed dynamic frontend features using React.js, Next.js, TypeScript & Tailwind CSS.
• Architected modular UI state with Redux Toolkit & integrated external REST APIs.
Single-flight cache stampede protection, RBAC guards & tenant row-level security.
Low-latency WebRTC peer-to-peer voice rooms & ElevenLabs conversational AI.
Instant optimistic feed mutations, realtime channels & Supabase RLS policies.
60fps spring physics, Lenis smooth inertia, zero CLS & Playwright E2E suite.
"Good engineering is not just about writing code — it's about building something that matters."
